poin.isi: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash: a model that takes text, images, audio and video at once, then uses tools on its own to edit videos or summarise films. It costs $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.47 per million output tokens.

For comparison, Gemini 3.8 Flash charges $0.75 for input and $3.75 for output per million tokens. On agentic and video tests, though, Qwen still trails Gemini — so this is about price, not about winning everywhere.
Start with the task that comes up most: reading documents, recording calls, or reviewing footage. Test two models on that task, compare quality and cost, then choose.

headline: AI MODELS KEEP GETTING CHEAPER,
BUT WHICH ONE FITS?
headline_caption: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, an all-round agent model at roughly a fifth of Gemini 3.8 Flash's price
subjudul: A lower price is not a reason to pick the cheapest — what matters is the fit.
